senses.gloss: Deer,Ⓒs.ⒹmfgaH, hariRaH, kuraMgaH, kuraMgamaH, vAtAyuH, ajinayoniH; pfzat m., kfzRasAraH, ruruH, SaMbaraH, rOhizaH, vAtapramIH (‘varieties of d(eer)’).

Derange,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓviparyas 4 U, vikzip 6 P, kramaM-vyavasTAM-BaMj 7 P, or upahan 2 P, vi-kzuB c., saMkF 6 P, AkulIkf 8 U.
Ⓝ[Derang]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓvyasta, anavasTita, magnakrama, avyavasTita, vikzipta, saMkIrRa; ‘d(eranged) in mind’ unmatta, BrAMtacitta.
Ⓝ[Derange]ment,Ⓒs.ⒹvyutkramaH, prakramaBaMgaH, avyavasTA, vyastatA, akramaH, visUtratA, vEla-kzaRyaM; ‘d(erangement) of mind’ matiBramaH cittaviplavaH, mativiparyAsaH.

Deride,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓvi-upa-ava-has 1 P, upahAsA-spadI kf 8 U, avajYA 9 U, Barts 10 A, garh 1, 10 A; ‘to be d(erid)ed’ upahAsyatAM gam 1 P, upahAsAspadaM BU 1 P, ‘are d(erid)ed by all’ sarvajanasyopahAsyatAmupayAMti (Ka. 108)
Ⓝ[Derid]er,Ⓒs.ⒹupahAsakaH, avakzepakaH
Ⓝ[Derid]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹavahAsena, upahAsapUrvaM, sopa-hAsaM
ⓃDerision,Ⓒs.Ⓓupa-ava-hAsaH, avamAnanA, DikkAraH, avajYA, garhaRaM, nirBartsanaM^1.
ⓃDerisive,Ⓒa.ⒹsopahAsa, avahAsagarBa, avahAsin; upahAsya; garhya.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20161202.

Derogate,Ⓒv. t.ⒹalpIkf 8 U, nyUnIkf, laGayati (D.); See Depreciate.
Ⓝ[Derogat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹlaGUkaraRaM, apamAnaH, gOravanyUnatA avamAnanA, lAGavaM.
Ⓝ[Derogat]ory,Ⓒa.ⒹananurUpa, akIrtikara, lAGavakArin, asadfSa (SI f.); ayaSaskara (rI f.).
